project.name: AIOS local automation services
project.identity: The local automation and storage-service plane behind AIOS workflows.
project.audience: AIOS operators and workflows that need local events, imports, persistence, and maintenance.
project.core_loop: Receive a local event or maintenance request, apply bounded storage or hook logic, and leave durable evidence for the operating loop.
project.north_star: Local automation extends the operating loop without hiding side effects or bypassing governed storage boundaries.

scope.purpose: Run the local hooks, importers, storage maintenance, and service operations that keep the operating layer connected to real work.
scope.boundary: Owns bin and services automation, hooks, importers, storage maintenance, and the CTS prototype; dashboard presentation and context policy remain outside this child.

mvp.definition: The scoped boundary is explicitly ratified, its parent outcome is clear, and its smallest local proof is repeatable.

complete_product.definition: The scoped boundary remains aligned through changes, interfaces, and user-visible or consumer-facing verification.

outcomes.name: The AIOS local automation services boundary advances its parent outcome without silently taking on sibling responsibilities.
